name: Shirasaki Marika
source:
A girl who gained unusual powers by trying out the urban legend her classmates told her about.  When she was attacked by a black mist monster, the protagonist and Asaoka saved her. Since then, she has been devoted to the protagonist like a loyal dog.

She is known on campus as a beautiful prodigy, but her cold attitude toward others and her appearance make her difficult to approach.

She is blunt and sharp-tongued when dealing with people she is not used to dealing with.
